description: This file is a code-behind for an ASP.NET WebForms page 'ShowAns.aspx', handling the display and submission of students' answers and marks in an online examination system. It interacts with a SQL database to fetch and update student answers, marks, and course-related data.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Partial class for the ShowAns.aspx page, handling page load, button clicks, and database interactions related to displaying student answers and submitting marks.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page activation; retrieves student answers from database and displays them in UI controls based on session data.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to AdminPanel.aspx when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to AdminQueue.aspx when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to AdminLeaderboard.aspx when the leaderboard button is clicked.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Handles the submission of marks, updates database records with total marks, removes the student from the course queue, and redirects to AdminCourseQueue.aspx.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to LoginPage.aspx.
